text: 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens in good health.2. Education background and age limit:-Applicants for undergraduate program must have senior high school diploma with good academic performance and be under the age of 22.-Applicants for master’s degree program must have bachelor’s degree and be under the age of 35.3.Obey the relevant laws of the PRC and meet the admission requirements of the host universities.4. Applicants must have a good academic record and merits.
